conflicts.source: grader round 2, extra[0]; moved to conflicts by the orchestrator when report.py learned conflicts
checks: must: one thing is at full contrast (this page's status); the rest of the popup is visibly quieter
must_not: several accents competing at full strength (coloured dots, filled pills, ink buttons)
conflicts.what: The B/W pill wants the chosen site option filled in ink; Focus Mode wants the status to be the only full-strength element. The always-on ink 'refuse' fill (near-white in dark mode) competes with the status.
options: soft fill at rest, ink on hover
outline at rest, fill on hover

extra: The B/W pill pick (ink-filled chosen segment) and the Focus Mode pick (no full-strength filled pills) pull against each other in this design: the always-on ink 'refuse' fill is the main thing that keeps the status from being the single full-contrast element.
Dark mode inverts the site-choice fill to near-white, which is the brightest element in the dark popup and outshines the maroon status field.
